notes.title: Add BHaptics Support
notes.notes:
We added Support for BHaptics! Now you should feel certain actions in the game which allows you to quickly react to it and also to be more immersed in the game.

We hope you will enjoy it!

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.notes:
Small Patch to fix some issues:
- the body was to much in VR, so it has been removed for oneself
- when playing without VR, the hands will now also get blue lines when it is possible to activate something
- Lighting of the Boss has been fixed
